label: Hubitat Elevation C-8 home automation hub
description: Hubitat Elevation C-8 is a local automation hub with Zigbee 3.0, Z-Wave 800, Matter and Bluetooth radios plus its own web administration interface. It is dual-homed on the IP side - a 10/100 RJ45 Ethernet port and built-in 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (C-8 and later) - and Hubitat explicitly warns that the hub does not support PoE, so the Ethernet port must be fed from a normal access port.
